nodes.label: Methodology — How a Marketing Plan Gets Made
Marketing Operations Stack — Skills + MCPs per AARRR Stage
Team and Agency Model — Hire for Strategy, Outsource Execution
Forecasting Reality Check (rationale: under $100M ARR, all forecasts are educated guesses; quarterly review adjusts the plan rather than treating monthly variance as failure)
Marketing Ops Stack Thesis (rationale: small team + fCMO + agentic tooling produces the output of a 15-20 person traditional marketing org)
Skills + MCPs Mapped to AARRR Stages

Strategy In-House, Execution Outsourced (rationale: full-time hires take months to ramp and years to develop expertise; best agencies/contractors deliver immediately with cross-industry pattern recognition)
Three Core Marketing Functions (Growth / Product / Content Marketing)

π-Shaped First Marketing Hire (rationale: the first strategic hire should combine two deep skill sets rather than one T-shaped depth, and be titled Manager/Lead not CMO/VP so there's headroom to scale the org later)
Marketing Mental Models Library (foundational, buyer-psychology, persuasion, pricing, design, growth)
Six-Component Offer Anatomy (condensed, in offers SKILL.md)

Bonuses-as-Objection-Handlers (rationale: each bonus should close a specific named buying objection rather than being a generic extra; stated bonus values must total under 2x the core price and be defensible)

Real vs. Fake Scarcity/Urgency (rationale: fake scarcity converts once then destroys trust permanently because buyers compare notes online; real scarcity compounds while fake scarcity faces trust collapse by month 6)
Ad Copy Formula Library (PAS, BAB, Social Proof Lead, Feature-Benefit Bridge, Direct Response)
